enable_responder.description: Enable or disable mDNS responder (announcing services and host records).

enable_querier.description: Enable or disable mDNS querier (querying for services and hosts).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to enable mDNS on (e.g., ['eth0', 'wlan0']). If empty, use all up interfaces.

hostname.description: Custom hostname to announce via mDNS (e.g., 'mydevice.local'). Leave empty to use system hostname.

ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for mDNS records (RFC 6762 recommends 120s).

multicast_ttl.description: Multicast TTL for outbound packets. 1 restricts to loopback; 255 is standard for full network propagation.

max_queries.description: Maximum number of concurrent mDNS queries to handle (prevents resource exhaustion).

hide_local_services.description: If true, do not announce locally registered services via mDNS (e.g., when using Avahi or systemd-resolved instead).

allow_services.description: Whitelist of mDNS service types to announce (e.g., ['_http._tcp', '_ssh._tcp']). If empty, all services are allowed unless denied.

deny_services.description: Blacklist of mDNS service types to suppress. Takes precedence over allow list.

txt_records.description: List of custom DNS-SD TXT records with arbitrary key-value pairs per service.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: debug, info, warn, or error.

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for service management (e.g., /var/run/mdnsd.pid).
